H1.quote: The owner-entered diet trial of Rabbit diet ran from Sep 17, 2026 to Oct 20, 2026.
H1.why: The trial is named with dates but without any adherence or confounder scope. The fact table does not print a trial_reading line here, but the summary still presents the trial as a clean bounded period. It also omits that chicken foods were first fed Oct 21, so the reader may take the trial as the clean period.

H2.quote: Vomiting: 6 entries on 4 days from Oct 26 to Oct 31.
H2.why: Placing the vomiting window right before the trial dates, with the trial ending Oct 20, invites reading vomiting as starting after the trial ended or after the diet change. The source line adds the 0-entry stretch and the chicken-foods side-by-side caveat, which the summary drops.

H3.why: No refusal or intake content in the facts or summary.

H4.why: The prior quiet stretch (0 entries Oct 19-25) is omitted. Picking Oct 26 as the start could read as onset, while the zero-entry week is only absence of logging, not confirmed absence of vomiting.

H5.quote: 6 entries on 4 days from Oct 26 to Oct 31.
H5.why: The window is given, but the logged-day denominator is not printed in the table either; the 0 entries Oct 19 to Oct 25 comparison is dropped, so the count lacks the context its line carries.

H6.why: All stated figures match the source lines.

H7.why: The band is empty, so there is no live flag to soften.
